rows.label: Rod bank D target
rows.description: Bank D, a shutdown bank. Pull it out to add reactivity; push it in to take it away. Rods move slowly, so be patient.

rows.label: Rod bank C target
rows.description: Bank C, a shutdown bank. Withdraw to add reactivity, insert to remove. The drive speed limits how fast it follows.

rows.label: Rod bank B target
rows.description: Bank B, a shutdown bank. Normally parked out at power. Rods drive at a fixed slow rate.

rows.label: Rod bank A target
rows.description: Bank A, the regulating bank. This is the one you trim with for fine power control.

rows.label: Rod bank D insertion
rows.description: Where bank D actually is, 0 = fully out, 1 = fully in. Follows the lever with a delay.

rows.label: Rod bank C insertion
rows.description: Where bank C actually is, 0 = fully out, 1 = fully in. Follows the lever with a delay.

rows.label: Rod bank B insertion
rows.description: Where bank B actually is, 0 = fully out, 1 = fully in. Follows the lever with a delay.

rows.label: Rod bank A insertion
rows.description: Where bank A actually is, 0 = fully out, 1 = fully in. Follows the lever with a delay.

rows.label: All rods target
rows.description: Moves all four banks to one target at once. Handy, and also a very good way to surprise yourself.

rows.label: Rod integrity (worst bank)
rows.description: Condition of the most worn control bank. Rods wear with use; low integrity means weaker shutdown worth.

rows.label: Rod drive speed
rows.description: Average rod drive speed. Slow in normal operation, fast after a SCRAM.

rows.label: Core thermal power
rows.description: Reactor thermal power in megawatts of the 180 MWt plant. 100 percent is 180.

rows.label: Core power percent
rows.description: Reactor power as a percentage of rated. Trips on high flux above the setpoint.

rows.label: Excore neutron flux
rows.description: Neutron flux seen by the detectors outside the core, counts per second. Spans many decades at startup.

rows.label: Sector neutron flux
rows.description: Flux in one core sector, counts per second. Good for spotting that the power is not even.

rows.label: Total reactivity
rows.description: Net reactivity in pcm. Zero is critical, positive is climbing, negative is falling. Aim for zero.

rows.label: Rod reactivity
rows.description: Reactivity held by the control rods, always negative. More rods in means more negative.

rows.label: Boron reactivity
rows.description: Reactivity held by dissolved boron. More boron, more negative, and it changes slowly.

rows.label: Doppler reactivity
rows.description: Fuel temperature feedback. Hotter fuel absorbs more neutrons, which keeps power honest.

rows.label: Moderator reactivity
rows.description: Coolant temperature and density feedback. Usually a stabilising push back against power changes.

rows.label: Reactor period
rows.description: Time for power to change by a factor of e. Small positive numbers mean power is rising fast.

rows.label: Decay heat power
rows.description: Heat from fission products after shutdown, as a fraction of rated power. It does not care that you scrammed.

rows.label: Total heat power
rows.description: Fission plus decay heat, as a fraction of rated power. This is what the coolant has to carry away.

rows.label: Reactor critical
rows.description: Lit while the reactor is critical (net reactivity at zero or above). The point of no return, gently.

rows.label: Fuel temperature
rows.description: Fuel temperature. Alarm at 1200 degC; fuel does not enjoy being hotter than that.

rows.label: Xenon reactivity
rows.description: Reactivity lost to xenon-135. Peaks hours after a power cut and can lock you out of a restart.

rows.label: Iodine reactivity
rows.description: Reactivity effect of iodine-135, the parent that decays into xenon.

rows.label: Xenon-135 inventory
rows.description: How much xenon-135 is in the core, scaled 0 to 1. Burns off at power, builds up after shutdown.

rows.label: Iodine-135 inventory
rows.description: How much iodine-135 is in the core, scaled 0 to 1. Today's iodine is tomorrow's xenon.

rows.label: Borate rate
rows.description: Adds boron to the coolant, in ppm per second. Lowers reactivity slowly. Think of it as a very gentle brake.

rows.label: Dilute rate
rows.description: Dilutes boron with clean water, in ppm per second. Raises reactivity slowly. Gentle accelerator, no refunds.

rows.label: Boron concentration
rows.description: Boron concentration in the coolant, parts per million. Alarm below 400.

rows.label: NaOH rate
rows.description: Doses sodium hydroxide to push coolant pH up (or down with negative). Keeps the chemistry in the lane.

rows.label: Ion exchange rate
rows.description: Ion exchanger flow. Scrubs the coolant and pulls pH back toward neutral.

rows.label: Coolant pH
rows.description: Coolant pH. The healthy band is 6.0 to 8.2; outside it the pH alarm lights.

rows.label: Charging pump
rows.description: Starts and stops the charging pump that tops up the primary loop. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Charging flow
rows.description: Charging pump flow, scaled 0 to 1. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Letdown valve
rows.description: Letdown valve opening, draining water out of the primary loop. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Letdown flow
rows.description: Letdown flow, scaled 0 to 1. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Primary flow demand
rows.description: Reactor coolant pump demand. More flow carries more heat, less flow makes everything hotter.

rows.label: Primary flow loop A
rows.description: Primary coolant flow as a fraction of normal. Low flow alarms at 40 percent.

rows.label: Primary flow loop B
rows.description: Loop B primary flow. Waits for the loops to be split in the model.

rows.label: RCP A
rows.description: Start and stop switch for reactor coolant pump A. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: RCP B
rows.description: Start and stop switch for reactor coolant pump B. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: RCP A running
rows.description: Red when reactor coolant pump A is running. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: RCP B running
rows.description: Red when reactor coolant pump B is running. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Primary temp loop A
rows.description: Primary coolant temperature. Alarm above 330 degC.

rows.label: Primary temp loop B
rows.description: Loop B primary temperature. Waits for the loops to be split in the model.

rows.label: Primary pressure
rows.description: Primary system pressure in bar. Alarms above 165 and below 100.

rows.label: Subcooling margin
rows.description: Margin between coolant temperature and boiling. Alarm below 15 degC; keep it comfortable.

rows.label: Pressurizer level demand
rows.description: Pressurizer water level target. Sets how much steam cushion the primary loop has.

rows.label: Pressurizer level
rows.description: Pressurizer level. Alarm below 40 percent; the pressurizer should never run dry.

rows.label: Heater power demand
rows.description: Pressurizer heater power. More heat raises primary pressure.

rows.label: Heater power
rows.description: Pressurizer heater power in use, scaled 0 to 1. Zero raises the heaters-off tile.

rows.label: Spray flow demand
rows.description: Pressurizer spray demand. Cool water into the steam bubble to bring pressure down.

rows.label: Spray flow
rows.description: Pressurizer spray flow, scaled 0 to 1. Fully open raises the spray fault tile.

rows.label: PORV open/close
rows.description: Power-operated relief valve. Press to open or close it; it lifts to dump pressure. Guarded for good reason.

rows.label: PORV block valve
rows.description: Block valve in front of the PORV, to isolate a leaking relief. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: PORV block position
rows.description: Shows whether the PORV block valve is open or closed. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: SG level loop A
rows.description: Steam generator water level. Alarm below 25 percent; dry generators make poor heat sinks.

rows.label: SG level loop B
rows.description: Loop B steam generator level. Waits for the loops to be split in the model.

rows.label: SG pressure loop A
rows.description: Secondary side pressure in bar. Alarm above 80.

rows.label: SG pressure loop B
rows.description: Loop B secondary pressure. Waits for the loops to be split in the model.

rows.label: Secondary temp loop A
rows.description: Secondary side temperature.

rows.label: Steam space fraction
rows.description: Fraction of the steam generator that is steam rather than water.

rows.label: Steam flow loop A
rows.description: Steam leaving the generator for the turbine, in kW of thermal energy.

rows.label: Steam flow loop B
rows.description: Loop B steam flow. Waits for the loops to be split in the model.

rows.label: MSIV A
rows.description: Main steam isolation valve A. Closing it cuts steam to the turbine. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: MSIV B
rows.description: Main steam isolation valve B. Closing it cuts steam to the turbine. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: MSIV A position
rows.description: Position of main steam isolation valve A. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: MSIV B position
rows.description: Position of main steam isolation valve B. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Feedwater flow demand
rows.description: Feedwater flow demand. Match it to the steam you are taking out or the level will wander.

rows.label: Feed flow loop A
rows.description: Feedwater flow to the steam generator, fraction of normal. Alarm if it fails while power is up.

rows.label: Feed flow loop B
rows.description: Loop B feedwater flow. Waits for the loops to be split in the model.

rows.label: Feed availability
rows.description: How much feedwater the feed system can actually supply, 0 to 1. Drops when the hotwell runs low.

rows.label: Feed regulating valve A
rows.description: Feed regulating valve A opening. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Feed regulating valve B
rows.description: Feed regulating valve B opening. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Feed pump A
rows.description: Start and stop switch for feed pump A. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Feed pump B
rows.description: Start and stop switch for feed pump B. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Auxiliary feed pump
rows.description: Auxiliary feed pump, the backup when the main feed is lost. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Condensate pump A
rows.description: Condensate pump A, moving condensed steam back to the feed system. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Condensate pump B
rows.description: Condensate pump B, moving condensed steam back to the feed system. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Hotwell level
rows.description: Condenser hotwell inventory. Low levels starve the feed pumps, and the alarm warns you first.

rows.label: Turbine throttle
rows.description: Turbine throttle. Opening it draws more steam, which pulls reactor power up behind it.

rows.label: Throttle position
rows.description: Where the turbine throttle valve actually is.

rows.label: Steam dump demand
rows.description: Steam dump demand. Sends steam straight to the condenser, bypassing the turbine.

rows.label: Steam dump position
rows.description: How far the steam dump valves are open.

rows.label: Turbine speed
rows.description: Turbine speed. 3000 is synchronous; trips below 2550 on the grid or above 3300.

rows.label: Turbine shaft power
rows.description: Mechanical power on the turbine shaft, in kW.

rows.label: Turbine auto load
rows.description: Toggles turbine load-following. In auto, the plant follows the grid demand and re-closes the breaker for you.

rows.label: Reset turbine/BOP trips
rows.description: Resets turbine and balance-of-plant trips once the cause is cleared.

rows.label: Vacuum pump
rows.description: Condenser vacuum pump speed. Keeps the shell pressure low so the turbine can breathe out.

rows.label: Cooling water demand
rows.description: Cooling water flow through the condenser. Lose it and the vacuum goes with it.

rows.label: Condenser pressure
rows.description: Condenser shell pressure in bar. Warns above 1.3 and trips the turbine above 1.6.

rows.label: Cooling water flow
rows.description: Cooling water flow, fraction of normal. Alarm below 30 percent.

rows.label: Cooling tower heat rejection
rows.description: Heat the cooling tower is throwing away, in kW. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Cooling tower water delta-T
rows.description: Temperature rise of the cooling tower water. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Circulating water pump A
rows.description: Circulating water pump A for the condenser. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Circulating water pump B
rows.description: Circulating water pump B for the condenser. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Circulating water flow
rows.description: Circulating water flow to the condenser. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Generator output
rows.description: Electrical power the generator is delivering, in kW. Zero until the breaker is closed.

rows.label: Grid frequency
rows.description: Grid frequency. Nominal 50 Hz; alarm more than half a hertz away.

rows.label: Grid output
rows.description: Power going to the grid, as a fraction of the demand scale.

rows.label: Grid demand
rows.description: Grid demand. In manual turbine mode it sets how hard the grid pulls on the generator.

rows.label: Generator breaker
rows.description: Generator breaker. Close to put the generator on the grid, but only when it is in step. Guarded, and rightly so.

rows.label: Breaker closed (red)
rows.description: Red when the generator breaker is closed and the unit is on the grid.

rows.label: Breaker open (green)
rows.description: Green when the generator breaker is open and the unit is off the grid.

rows.label: Out-of-sync dwell
rows.description: Seconds the generator has been running out of step with the grid. At 60 the breaker trips.

rows.label: Synchroscope
rows.description: Phase difference between generator and grid. Close the breaker near the top, and not before. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Incoming (generator) volts
rows.description: Generator terminal voltage on the sync panel. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Running (grid) volts
rows.description: Grid voltage on the sync panel. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Incoming (generator) frequency
rows.description: Generator frequency on the sync panel. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Running (grid) frequency
rows.description: Grid frequency on the sync panel. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Sync permissive
rows.description: Lit when generator and grid are close enough in step to close. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Sync select
rows.description: Selects which generator the sync panel is looking at. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Generator reactive power
rows.description: Reactive power the generator is exchanging with the grid. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Generator terminal voltage
rows.description: Generator terminal voltage. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Generator field current
rows.description: Generator field current, which sets excitation. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Governor raise
rows.description: Nudges turbine speed up while syncing. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Governor lower
rows.description: Nudges turbine speed down while syncing. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Voltage raise
rows.description: Raises generator voltage while syncing. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Voltage lower
rows.description: Lowers generator voltage while syncing. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Unit transformer breaker
rows.description: Breaker between the generator and the unit transformer. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Auxiliary transformer breaker
rows.description: Breaker feeding the auxiliary transformer for plant loads. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Bus A voltage
rows.description: Voltage on safety bus A. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Bus B voltage
rows.description: Voltage on safety bus B. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Bus tie breaker
rows.description: Ties bus A to bus B so one supply can carry both. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: House load
rows.description: Electrical load of the plant itself, in kW. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Offsite power breaker
rows.description: Breaker connecting the plant to offsite grid power. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Offsite voltage
rows.description: Voltage of the offsite power supply. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Offsite power available
rows.description: Lit while offsite power is available. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Diesel start
rows.description: Starts the emergency diesel generator. Not modelled yet, but it will be nice to have around.

rows.label: Diesel breaker
rows.description: Breaker connecting the diesel generator to its bus. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Diesel running
rows.description: Lit while the diesel generator is running. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Diesel voltage
rows.description: Diesel generator output voltage. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: SCRAM
rows.description: Trips the reactor: all rods drop in. Lift the cover, then press. When in doubt, this is the answer.

rows.label: Reset SCRAM
rows.description: Resets the SCRAM latch once things are safe, so the rods can be withdrawn again.

rows.label: Operating mode
rows.description: Operating mode selector: Shutdown, Nominal, Maximum. The plant also updates it from power level on its own.

rows.label: Pause clock
rows.description: Pauses the simulation clock. The plant waits politely while you think.

rows.label: Resume clock
rows.description: Resumes the simulation clock after a pause.

rows.label: Time scale x0.5
rows.description: Halves the time scale. For when things are happening too fast.

rows.label: Time scale x2
rows.description: Doubles the time scale. For when you are waiting for xenon.

rows.label: Skip ahead 10 min
rows.description: Skips ahead ten minutes at top speed. Stops early on a trip or SCRAM.

rows.label: Acknowledge alarms
rows.description: Acknowledge and silence. Flashing tiles go steady and the horn stops; a new alarm flashes again.

rows.label: Clock paused
rows.description: Lit while the clock is paused or frozen by an emergency.

rows.label: Game clock
rows.description: Elapsed plant time in minutes. Counts at the current time scale.

rows.label: Assistant tier
rows.description: How much help the plant assistant gives: off, advisory, supervised or autopilot.

rows.label: Mission select
rows.description: Chooses the scenario the assistant coaches you through. Zero is free play.

rows.label: Reactor scrammed
rows.description: Lit when the reactor has been scrammed. Reset on the scram reset button when safe.

rows.label: High neutron flux
rows.description: Neutron flux above the trip setpoint. The protection system SCRAMs on this.

rows.label: Short reactor period
rows.description: Power is rising faster than the auto-slow period. Slow down, whatever you are doing.

rows.label: Fuel temperature high
rows.description: Fuel temperature above 1200 degC. Find the cause fast.

rows.label: Xenon pit
rows.description: Xenon reactivity below -800 pcm. A restart may be impossible until it decays.

rows.label: Operating mode annunciator
rows.description: Briefly lit when the operating mode changes. A notice, not a fault.

rows.label: Rod wear
rows.description: At least one control bank has worn below 80 percent integrity.

rows.label: Primary pressure high
rows.description: Primary pressure above 165 bar. Spray, open the PORV, or reduce power.

rows.label: Primary pressure low
rows.description: Primary pressure below 100 bar. Check the heaters and the level.

rows.label: Subcooling low
rows.description: Margin to boiling below 15 degC. Cool the primary down or raise pressure.

rows.label: PORV open
rows.description: The relief valve is open. Pressure is going somewhere, hopefully intentionally.

rows.label: RCP low flow
rows.description: Primary flow below 25 percent. The core is not being cooled properly.

rows.label: Primary flow low
rows.description: Primary flow below 40 percent. Check the pump demand.

rows.label: Primary temperature high
rows.description: Primary coolant above 330 degC. Add flow, cut power, or take more steam.

rows.label: Pressurizer level low
rows.description: Pressurizer level below 40 percent. Do not let it drain.

rows.label: Heaters off
rows.description: Pressurizer heaters are off. Pressure will drift down.

rows.label: Spray fault
rows.description: Spray valve at full open. Either you meant it or something is stuck.

rows.label: Boron low
rows.description: Boron below 400 ppm. Shutdown margin is thin.

rows.label: pH drift
rows.description: Coolant pH outside 6.0 to 8.2. Use the NaOH dose or the ion exchanger.

rows.label: SG pressure high
rows.description: Secondary pressure above 80 bar. Open the throttle or the dump.

rows.label: SG level low
rows.description: Steam generator level below 25 percent. More feedwater, now.

rows.label: SG relief open
rows.description: The secondary relief valve is open. Steam is being thrown away.

rows.label: Feedwater failure
rows.description: Feedwater has failed while the reactor is at power. Cut power or restore feed.

rows.label: Cooling water loss
rows.description: Condenser cooling water below 30 percent. Vacuum is next.

rows.label: Turbine overspeed trip
rows.description: Turbine tripped on overspeed, above 3300 rpm.

rows.label: Turbine underspeed trip
rows.description: Turbine tripped on underspeed, below 2550 rpm while on the grid.

rows.label: Condenser low vacuum trip
rows.description: Turbine tripped on low condenser vacuum, above 1.6 bar.

rows.label: SG low level trip
rows.description: Turbine tripped because the steam generator level was too low.

rows.label: Generator out of sync trip
rows.description: Breaker tripped after 60 seconds out of step with the grid.

rows.label: Turbine tripped
rows.description: The turbine is tripped. Fix the cause, then reset on the turbine trip reset.

rows.label: Condenser vacuum warning
rows.description: Condenser pressure above 1.3 bar. Vacuum is weakening; a trip follows at 1.6.

rows.label: Hotwell level low
rows.description: Hotwell inventory is low. The feed pumps will starve if it keeps falling.

rows.label: Grid frequency off-normal
rows.description: Grid frequency more than half a hertz from 50. The grid is having a moment.

rows.label: Loss of offsite power
rows.description: Offsite power lost. Time to find the diesel. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Bus undervoltage
rows.description: A bus voltage is low. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Diesel generator running
rows.description: The emergency diesel is running. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Out-of-phase close
rows.description: The breaker was closed out of phase. Ouch. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: RCP A trip
rows.description: Reactor coolant pump A has tripped. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: RCP B trip
rows.description: Reactor coolant pump B has tripped. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Feed pump trip
rows.description: A feed pump has tripped. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: MSIV closed
rows.description: A main steam isolation valve is not open. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Charging pump stopped
rows.description: The charging pump has stopped. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Circulating water loss
rows.description: Circulating water has stopped. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Reactor core page
rows.description: Screen: reactor core overview with power, rods, reactivity and clock state.

rows.label: Chemistry page
rows.description: Screen: boron, pH and chemistry rates with short trends.

rows.label: Event log page
rows.description: Screen: the running event log of what the plant and you have been up to.

rows.label: Primary loop page
rows.description: Screen: primary loop temperatures, pressure, level and flow.

rows.label: Secondary loop page
rows.description: Screen: steam generator pressure, level, feed and steam flow.

rows.label: Turbine and grid page
rows.description: Screen: turbine speed, generator output and grid frequency.

rows.label: Assistant terminal
rows.description: Screen: the plant assistant's advice, if you have it switched on.

rows.label: Mimic status board
rows.description: Screen: a one-glance status board of the whole plant.

rows.label: Grid and bus detail page
rows.description: Screen: grid and bus detail. Not modelled yet.

rows.label: Pump and valve lineup page
rows.description: Screen: pump and valve lineup. Not modelled yet.
